plugins.name: elastic
plugins.description: Elastic plugin for Claude - skills for building with the Elastic stack.

skills.name: cloud-onboarding
skills.description: Onboard an Elastic Cloud organization: configure the `elastic` CLI's Cloud context and API key, establish a default region, then invite users, assign predefined or custom Serverless project roles, and create or revoke Cloud API keys. Use when setting up Cloud authentication or when granting, modifying, or auditing user access to an organization and its projects.
headings: Cloud API keys with stack access
skills.description_zh: 初始化Elastic Cloud组织CLI上下文、API密钥与默认区域，邀请用户、配置Serverless角色并管理Cloud密钥和访问审计。

skills.name: cloud-provisioning
skills.description: Provision and operate Elastic Cloud infrastructure: create, connect to, update, and delete Serverless projects (Elasticsearch, Observability, Security); manage traffic filters (IP and AWS PrivateLink network security); and manage the lifecycle of Elastic Cloud Hosted deployments. Use when creating or performing day-2 operations on serverless projects or hosted deployments, or restricting their network access.
headings: Workflow: connect to an existing project
Day-2: list, get, update, delete, resume
Process: create and attach a filter
Day-2: get, update, shut down, restore
skills.description_zh: 创建、连接、更新和删除Elastic Cloud Serverless项目，管理Hosted部署生命周期及IP或PrivateLink流量限制。

skills.name: elasticsearch-anomaly-detection-explainer
skills.description: Explain Elasticsearch ML anomaly detection scores, model behavior, and result interpretation. Use when the user asks why a score is high or low, how the model learns, what the numbers mean, or how to troubleshoot unexpected anomaly scores.
headings: Why a score might be unexpectedly low
Why a score might be unexpectedly high
skills.description_zh: 解释Elasticsearch机器学习异常分数、模型学习与结果，排查意外高低分。

skills.name: elasticsearch-anomaly-detection
skills.description: Create and manage Elastic ML anomaly detection jobs via the API. Use when setting up jobs on an index or data stream, configuring jobs and datafeeds, or opening, starting, or stopping them.
skills.description_zh: 通过API创建管理Elastic异常检测作业及数据源，配置、打开、启动或停止任务。

skills.name: elasticsearch-cluster-health
skills.description: Diagnose a non-green Elasticsearch cluster and surface the single most likely cause with remediation. Use when an operator reports yellow or red status, unassigned shards, allocation failures, or wants read-only triage before deeper investigation. Teaches replica-vs-primary impact, allocation decider classification, and data-loss awareness.
skills.description_zh: 只读诊断Elasticsearch黄红集群、未分配分片与分配失败，指出最可能原因和修复，区分主副本影响及数据丢失风险。

skills.name: elasticsearch-esql
skills.description: Execute ES|QL (Elasticsearch Query Language) queries, use when the user wants to query Elasticsearch data, analyze logs, aggregate metrics, explore data, or create charts and dashboards from ES|QL results.
skills.description_zh: 执行Elasticsearch ES|QL查询，分析日志、聚合指标、探索数据并从结果生成图表或仪表板。

skills.name: elasticsearch-index-design
skills.description: Design and review Elasticsearch index mappings for stated access patterns: correct field types, text+keyword multi-fields, doc_values tuning, mapping-explosion avoidance, and explicit shard settings. Use when creating a new index, reviewing a mapping for storage or query performance, fixing wrong field types, or when the user asks which type to use for search, filter, sort, or aggregation on a field.
skills.description_zh: 按访问模式设计与审查Elasticsearch索引映射，选择字段类型、text与keyword多字段、doc_values及分片，避免映射膨胀。

skills.name: elasticsearch-ingest
skills.description: Load CSV and JSON files into Elasticsearch indices using the bulk API and explicit mappings when field types matter. Use when batch-importing local files, converting CSV rows or JSON arrays to NDJSON bulk format, or verifying document counts and mappings after ingest — not for Logstash pipelines, Beats, custom scripts, or index-to-index reindex.
skills.description_zh: 通过bulk API将本地CSV或JSON转为NDJSON载入Elasticsearch，必要时明确映射并核对文档数；不用于Logstash、Beats或重索引。

skills.name: elasticsearch-onboarding
skills.description: Help developers new to Elasticsearch get from zero to a working search experience. Guide them through understanding their intent, mapping their data, and building a search experience with best practices baked in. Use this when the user shows intent to build search-related functionality, asks about Elasticsearch-related concepts for their use case, or expresses the need for help getting started with Elasticsearch.
skills.description_zh: 引导新开发者从需求、数据映射到可运行Elasticsearch搜索体验，解释相关概念并落实搜索实践。

skills.name: elasticsearch-query-optimization
skills.description: Diagnose slow Elasticsearch Query DSL searches and propose measured fixes. Use when a search is slow, profile output shows an expensive clause, exact-match filters sit in scoring context, or leading wildcards dominate latency. Ground every recommendation in search profiling — move non-scoring clauses to filter context, eliminate leading wildcards, and re-profile to confirm improvement.
skills.description_zh: 根据Elasticsearch搜索剖析诊断慢Query DSL，调整无需评分条件至filter、去除前导通配，并重新剖析验证改进。

skills.name: elasticsearch-reindex
skills.description: Guide Elasticsearch reindex for performance: local and remote, slicing, throttling, task API. Use when copying or migrating indices, changing mappings, or transforming during reindex.
skills.description_zh: 指导Elasticsearch本地或远程重索引，配置切片、节流和任务API，用于复制迁移、改变映射及转换内容。

skills.name: elasticsearch-search-relevance
skills.description: Improve Elasticsearch search relevance for content and catalog indices: pin or promote results with query rules (correct rule type, criteria, and rule-query wiring) and tune organic ranking with multi_match, field boosts, and analysis grounded in the index mapping. Use when search results rank poorly, a specific document must appear first for a query, or the user asks to tune full-text matching — not for ES|QL analytics, index ingest, or cluster health.
headings: Improve "running shoes" when only `description` is searched
skills.description_zh: 改善Elasticsearch内容或商品搜索排序，配置置顶规则、条件及查询连接，按映射调整multi_match和字段权重，不用于分析查询、入库或集群健康。

skills.name: kibana-agent-builder
skills.description: Create and manage Kibana Agent Builder agents and custom tools. Use when asked to create, update, delete, test, or inspect agents or tools in Agent Builder, or when the user wants to understand what agents or tools already exist.
headings: Create an index search tool (eval pattern)
Answer "what agents already exist?" before creating
skills.description_zh: 创建、管理、测试和检查Kibana Agent Builder智能体与自定义工具。

skills.name: kibana-alerting-rules
skills.description: Create and manage Kibana alerting rules. Use when creating, updating, or managing rule lifecycle (enable, disable, mute, snooze), choosing metric threshold rule types and params, or read-only find/list with tag filters.
skills.description_zh: 创建和管理Kibana告警规则，选择指标阈值与参数，启停、静音、暂停并按标签只读查询。

skills.name: kibana-anomaly-detection
skills.description: Elastic ML anomaly detection — investigation/RCA, score explanation, job lifecycle troubleshooting, and job operations. Use when answering "what broke?"/"which entity?"/RCA, "why is score high/low?"/renormalization, "datafeed stopped"/"memory limit"/hard_limit, or configuring ML anomaly detection jobs. Reads results from `.ml-anomalies-*` and job state from ML REST APIs.
headings: Lifecycle for config changes (memory limit, query_delay)
skills.description_zh: 调查Elastic ML异常和根因，解释分数与重新归一化，排查数据源停止和内存限制，并管理作业、读取异常索引与API状态。

skills.name: kibana-dashboards
skills.description: Create and manage Kibana Dashboards and Lens visualizations. Use when you need to define dashboards and visualizations declaratively, version control them, or automate their deployment.
skills.description_zh: 声明式创建和管理Kibana仪表板与Lens可视化，支持版本控制和自动部署。

skills.name: kibana-workflows
skills.description: Author, validate, test, run, and inspect Elastic Workflow YAML definitions. Use when the user wants to turn natural language into a Kibana workflow, fix workflow YAML, understand triggers or steps, or run a quick test loop against a real Kibana.
skills.description_zh: 编写、验证、测试和运行Elastic Workflow YAML，理解触发器步骤，并在真实Kibana快速迭代。

skills.name: observability-k8s-investigation
skills.description: Investigate Kubernetes workload, node, and control-plane issues using OTel telemetry (EDOT). Use when diagnosing pod failures (CrashLoopBackOff, OOMKilled, Error), node pressure, resource exhaustion, image pull failures, admission rejections, autoscaling anomalies, or correlating K8s state with application signals. OTel ingest path only — the legacy ECS Kubernetes integration shape is out of scope.
skills.description_zh: 依据EDOT遥测调查Kubernetes工作负载、节点和控制面故障，分析崩溃、内存、调度、镜像、准入和扩缩容，并关联应用信号；不涵盖旧ECS集成。

skills.name: observability-llm-obs
skills.description: Answer questions about LLM and agentic-application behavior from data already ingested into Elastic: latency and error rate, token and cost utilization, response quality and guardrail events, and agentic call-chain orchestration. Use when the user asks about LLM monitoring, GenAI observability, token spend or AI cost, model latency, prompt or guardrail failures, or how an agent's tool-call chain executed.
headings: Process: determine what data is available
skills.description_zh: 基于Elastic已采集资料分析LLM与智能体延迟、错误、令牌成本、响应质量、护栏和工具调用链。

skills.name: observability-onboarding
skills.description: Onboard an application into Elastic Observability with the Elastic Distribution of OpenTelemetry (EDOT): route on language and runtime, detect and replace a classic Elastic APM agent, apply the required OTLP configuration, and then verify with ES|QL that traces, metrics, and logs actually arrive under the expected service name. Use when adding observability to a service, migrating off the classic Elastic APM agent, or debugging why an instrumented service is not showing up in Elastic.
skills.description_zh: 用EDOT为应用接入Elastic可观测性，按语言运行时替换经典APM、配置OTLP，并用ES|QL验证指定服务的追踪、指标和日志实际到达。

skills.name: observability-service-reliability
skills.description: Design and operate service reliability targets in Elastic Observability: choose an SLI type and a defensible target, pick a time window and budgeting method, create and maintain SLOs through the Kibana API, attach burn-rate alert rules, and decide when an SLO is the wrong instrument and a threshold rule, anomaly job, or synthetics monitor is right. Use when defining or reviewing SLOs and error budgets, tuning burn-rate alerting, reducing alert noise, or setting up availability monitoring for a user-facing endpoint.
headings: Process: route the reliability concern to an instrument
KQL is an API contract here, not a style choice
Process: alert on the SLO without adding noise
skills.description_zh: 设计并维护Elastic服务可靠性目标，选择SLI、目标、窗口与预算，通过Kibana管理SLO和燃尽告警，并判断阈值、异常或合成监控是否更适用。

skills.name: observability-sre-triage
skills.description: Triage a degraded or suspect service end to end: read SLO status and burn rate, check active alerting rules and ML anomalies, measure throughput, latency, and error rate, assess dependency health and infrastructure saturation, and funnel logs down to the failures that explain it. Use when someone asks whether a service is healthy, why it is slow or erroring, what is in its logs, or which attribute distinguishes the requests that are failing. Also use when someone asks for the query behind any of those signals — throughput, latency percentiles, error rate, dependency health, or log volume — over APM/OTel traces, metrics, or logs.
skills.description_zh: 端到端调查服务降级，核对SLO、告警、异常、吞吐延迟错误、依赖和基础设施，再定位解释故障的日志，提供对应APM或OTel查询。

skills.name: security-alert-triage
skills.description: Triage Elastic Security alerts — gather context, classify threats, create cases, and acknowledge. Use when triaging alerts, performing SOC analysis, or investigating detections.
headings: By host name — preferred when triaging a host
By agent ID — preferred when agent.id is known
skills.description_zh: 分流Elastic Security告警，收集背景、分类威胁、建立案件并确认告警，支持SOC调查。

skills.name: security-case-management
skills.description: Create, search, update, and manage SOC cases via the Kibana Cases API. Use when tracking incidents, linking alerts to cases, adding investigation notes, or managing triage output.
headings: Create (syncAlerts enabled by default; disable with --sync-alerts false)
Add comment, update (--tags merges with existing tags, does not replace)
skills.description_zh: 通过Kibana Cases API创建、搜索、更新SOC案件，关联告警并添加调查记录。

skills.name: security-detection-rule-management
skills.description: Create, tune, and manage Elastic Security detection rules (SIEM and Endpoint). Use for false positives, exceptions, new coverage, noisy rules, or rule management via Kibana API.
headings: Workflow: Tune a rule for false positives
Steps 1–2: Identify noisy rules and analyze false positives
Steps 4–5: Apply tuning, verify, and document
Steps 1–2: Define the threat, data sources, and fields
Step 3: Write and test the query
skills.name_hint: 安全 · detection · 规则 · management
skills.description_zh: 创建和调优Elastic Security检测规则，处理误报、例外、新覆盖与噪声，管理SIEM和端点规则。

skills.name: security-generate-security-sample-data
skills.description: Generate sample security events, attack scenarios, and synthetic alerts for Elastic Security. Use when demoing, populating dashboards, testing detection rules, or setting up a POC.
skills.name_hint: 安全 · 生成 · 安全 · sample · 数据
skills.description_zh: 为Elastic Security生成样例安全事件、攻击情景和合成告警，用于演示、仪表板、规则测试及PoC。
